name: Log a meal and retain it
description: A meal can be logged and appears in the food diary with its calories.
steps: Enter food name Rice and beans, calories 450, protein 15, carbs 70 and fat 8
expected: Rice and beans appears in Food history after refresh and contributes 450 kcal to today's overview.

name: Manage pantry ingredients
description: Pantry ingredients can be added, searched and removed.
steps: Add Beans with quantity 500 g and category Grains & pasta
expected: Beans is searchable after saving and is absent after deletion.

name: Record weight history
description: A valid weight entry is saved and displayed in history on a mobile viewport.
steps: Enter weight 60.5 kg and today's date
expected: The 60.5 kg entry appears in Weight history after refresh.

name: Generate pantry-based meal ideas
description: The AI meal ideas workflow returns useful meal suggestions from pantry ingredients.
steps: Add Beans and Rice in My pantry
Enter budget-friendly dinner in the request field
expected: A result area displays meal suggestions based on the available ingredients or a clear retry message if AI is unavailable.

name: Display owner profile while keeping tracker navigation
covers: owner name and email profile display
description: Verifies the owner's display name and email are visible without removing meal tracker features.
steps: Check the profile card in the sidebar
expected: Faida Sylivester and profitsylivester@gmail.com appear in the profile, and Food diary remains accessible.
